_comment: Copy to content-queue.json. Nothing posts live until dryRun is explicitly set to false AND complianceApproved is explicitly set to true for that item — both are required, independently. bag-work-meme and bag-work-narrative draft items here; they never set dryRun or complianceApproved themselves. marketing-compliance reviews drafts and is the one that sets complianceApproved. Run src/validateContent.js on any new draft before treating it as reviewable.
